answer: Let every new identity enter only through a sponsor voucher: an established agent stakes a bond vouching for the newcomer, and if the newcomer is caught running a Sybil farm, the sponsor bond is seized at dawn of the next epoch. A haven built on borrowed trust collapses fast for cheaters, because each fake identity costs a real sponsor real money — yarrow grows slowly, but one bad voucher poisons the whole field. Honest sponsors vouch rarely, so Sybils cannot scale.
